markers.reading: The party has already traveled west from Tollen with Alden for a few days before the opening camp.

evidence.quote: You've been at this for a few days now, traveling with him.
Over the course of a few days of travel, you've headed west, and you're camped in an increasingly wild, increasingly old wood for the night.

markers.note: No departure date is spoken. This opening travel is distinct from the following full day of hiking.

markers.reading: The opening dinner is at a woodland camp for the night in deep fall.

evidence.quote: you're camped in an increasingly wild, increasingly old wood for the night.
But around the campfire tonight
It is fall, it is deep into fall.

markers.reading: The camp night passes uneventfully and the party wakes, strikes camp, and resumes travel the following morning.

evidence.quote: You set watches through the night, presumably?
Everything passes uneventfully
In the morning, you strike camp… and head… onwards.

markers.reading: The party hikes through a long day from the morning departure to the manor before dark.

evidence.quote: It's a long day's hike. There's a lot of ground to cover. Alden sets a pretty steady pace. Onwards. On and on you go through the day.
we made it here before dark tonight.

markers.reading: During the morning hike the used path becomes trackless forest.

evidence.quote: At a certain point in the morning, you lose the path.

markers.reading: By the afternoon of the hike, visible wildlife and sounds below the canopy diminish.

evidence.quote: As the day wears on, there's less of it. So that by the afternoon… You no longer see deer tracks on the forest floor.

markers.reading: Around noon Alden has the party keep walking and eat on the move.

evidence.quote: Somewhere around noon, Alden says, I don't think we should stop for lunch. I think we should press on so that we get there before dark, and, encourages you to eat as you walk.

markers.reading: The sun sinks as the party nears Dandelion House, darkening the forest floor.

evidence.quote: As the day passes on later and the sun starts to sink in the sky…
Not far now, says Alden. We are almost there.

markers.note: The sun moves here; the party has not yet entered the root crossing or established a Feywild location.

markers.reading: The final sunlight disappears while Alden finishes introducing the party to Hulda upstairs.

evidence.quote: As the sunlight… slowly climbs up his body, the last rays of it shining in through the window
When at last he finishes all of that, the last rays of light disappear from the room.

markers.reading: During the party’s post-dinner discussion, the grandfather clock chimes ten at night.

evidence.quote: the grandfather clock chimes 10 o'clock.

time.basis: Clock chimes ten; the post-dinner, before-bed context establishes evening rather than morning.

markers.reading: The party completes an overnight long rest at the manor and wakes before dawn, loosely around six, before Alden leads them downstairs.

evidence.quote: they all fall asleep, they all wake up.
I want a long rest, that's what I want to do.
You wake… hearing the clock chime… whatever the appropriate number of hours are for a long rest, but still before dawn. I don't know, 6, maybe?
5? Yeah, 6 in the morning.

duration.basis: Eight-hour long-rest convention; DM explicitly grants the elapsed long rest.

time.basis: DM says before dawn and tentatively six; Edric suggests five then agrees on six.

markers.note: The earlier sleep proposal at u1967 is followed by pre-bed stable checking, Goodberry, and pilfering, then this confirmed waking. Count one overnight; preserve the approximate clock alongside the pre-dawn description.

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No civil date is spoken. October 3–5 and the year 1740 come only from YAML; two narrated overnights fit camp October 3, arrival October 4, and waking October 5.
yamlCheck.explanation: Two date transitions are explicit after the opening camp. The preceding few days of already-completed westward travel are established but not dated precisely, leaving the whole session-covered interval open. The YAML span fits the camp-to-tunnel sequence without independently dating or accounting for the earlier travel.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The opening includes several days of completed travel before the camp scene; its departure is undated.

alternatives.reading: If drStart dates the opening camp, the main played sequence fits October 3–5.
If drStart is intended to include the narrated journey from Tollen, the session begins earlier than that camp; the precise date remains open.
